sourceSentences: Shaco becomes invisible for a duration, and after a 0.125-second delay, he blinks to the target location.
Deceive's invisibility breaks when Shaco uses a basic attack or casts Two-Shiv Poison, but not from casting Jack in the Box or Hallucinate.
Backstab Bonus: The attack will critically strike
Shaco's basic attacks slow enemies for 2 seconds while Two-Shiv Poison is not on cooldown.
Shaco throws a dagger at the target enemy that deals magic damage, if they are below 30% of their maximum health, and slows them for 3 seconds.
Shaco vanishes for 0.5 seconds and blinks in the target direction while creating a clone of himself that is summoned in the opposite direction
The clone will explode upon dying or expiring to deal magic damage to nearby enemies and deploy three Jack in the Box that activate instantly
If the explosion hits at least one minion, the boxes will fear all enemies regardless of their unit type for 2.2 seconds, causing enemy champions to be feared for the non-champion fear duration.
If Deceive and Hallucinate are used in quick succession, the clone will spawn in the direction of the cursor instead.
It's also crucial to remember that your stealth does not break when you cast W or your R. You will remain inside of it.
the damage also increases when the enemy is less than 30% HP. So, using your E as an execute is often the best tactic.
technically dashing when you come out of your ultimate. So, if you are close enough to certain terrain, you can actually jump over it.
Lesson seven, Q and E. Q in and E the enemy. That simple.
Lesson nine, Q backstab backstab R. Q in, backstab twice and R away from the enemy.
backstab her once, twice, and then press R to the side so I dodge her reaction.

You can hover over walls with your ultimate as either a clone or the real you, depending on how you hover. If I point it at a wall, I will fly over the wall. If you hover the other way around, your clone will fly through the wall.
not a good idea to use E first, because if you then auto-attack the enemy, you won't get the new slow.
Une bonne façon d'utiliser cela est d'avoir peu de PV, puis d'enchaîner A et R directement sur l'ennemi, en espérant qu'il attaque instinctivement le Shaco affaibli.
En connaissant cette distance, vous pouvez franchir certains murs avec le R de Shaco. Il faut juste garder à l'esprit que vous apparaissez vers le curseur.
Si je place mon curseur ici et que j'appuie sur R, je passe le mur mais pas le clone.
